purpose: Provide deterministic translation-only min/max limits on one caller-selected fixed world-space direction projection while preserving slack motion inside the interval and free perpendicular translation.

properties.limits: bounded explicit fixed world-space directions with minOffset and/or maxOffset
properties.options: bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

limitations: slack motion inside the allowed interval is intentionally free
direction does not rotate with bodies
not a full prismatic or slider joint
no angular inertia, rotating anchors, angular limits or motors
the standalone wrapper performs its own donor-core step and is not yet integrated into the shared composer/activity/isolation stack
post-core projection can change positions after donor contact evidence was produced

proves: normalized fixed-direction one-sided and ranged limits
slack motion inside the projected interval

truth.basis: The capability is explicitly a fixed world-space projected translation range primitive and is not relabeled as a rotating prismatic joint.

agency.basis: Callers choose direction, min/max bounds, activity state and bounded solver factors/iterations.

continuity.basis: The donor core remains byte-for-byte preserved while this capability is added as an additive wrapper.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Shared-stack integration is left as a later explicit gate instead of chaining standalone wrappers and risking a second donor-core step.
